Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion
consistent with whiplash-type cervical strain. Over the course of six visits, the patient received a structured program
of manual therapy, targeted stretching, and graded home exercise. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm
the cervical soft tissue injury, and the objective deficits documented at intake are reflected in the follow-up
measurements. No piror injury to the cervical region is known from the patient history or records reviewed. Recovery
has been progressing, though it has taken somewhat longer than is typical for this presentation, and the pace of
improvement has been gradual. At this stage it is not yet clear whether the injury is wholly attributable to this collision,
and further assessment is planned to clarify the causal relationship. Billing records reviewed for the episode show no
repeated charges for the same services. Ongoing care will focus on restoring full mobility and strength, with
reassessment at defined intervals.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
